SEARCH
Package services

Class SearchService

java.lang.Object
services.SearchService
@Singleton public final class SearchService extends Object
Shares asynchronous page requests and retains bounded, expiring snapshots.

AI assistance: implementation support for Phase 5 validation and caching; Phase 7 cached navigation.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
